title: parity_right_click_effect duplicates app/main.odin's effect_right_click — the right-click pin covers a harness copy, not the app handler
detail: Bodies verified identical today (only the receiver indirection differs), but the input_parity_right_click scenario pins the harness's private copy, not the app's live handler; a future edit to effect_right_click silently desyncs the W3/W5 transcription pin.
recommended_fix: Give the shared body one home: move it into app/input as a helper taking (Input, ^rnd.View, ^pp.Topology, ^pp.Catalogs) and have both effect_right_click and the parity hook call it, so the pin and the app cannot drift.
